findings.evidence: docs/modules/plans/overview.md Boundaries section states the plans module 'calls requireUserId() (from @/lib/requireUser) and, on the page side, getServerSession(authOptions) (from @/lib/auth)' - i.e. requireUserId() is used for API routes while getServerSession(authOptions) is used only for page-side rendering, not for the API routes themselves. FR-3 in this same document correctly preserves that split ('requireUserId() (API routes) or getServerSession(authOptions) (pages)').
findings.locationHint: all performed against the current user resolved via `requireUserId()` /
findings.message: FR-5 attributes both `requireUserId()` and `getServerSession(authOptions)` to the four listed operations, all of which are API routes (POST/GET/GET/DELETE /api/plans...). Per docs/modules/plans/overview.md, getServerSession(authOptions) is used only 'on the page side', not by the API routes, so listing it alongside requireUserId() for these API-route operations is inconsistent with the source module overview.
